title: fix: restore Talk and incognito static gates
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Restores main's architecture and suppression-inventory checks after the Talk lookup and incognito history changes in #165546 and #165548.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior change or migration. Talk lookups retain their partial indexes and malformed-JSON handling; incognito asynchronous grants remain rejected and their rejected promises remain handled.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Talk worker used a typed raw CASE expression for an ordinary query. Kysely's CASE and function builders express the same guarded JSON lookup with literal paths, preserving SQLite's partial-index matching without an allowlist entry.

The history fixture intentionally tests an invalid asynchronous transaction grant. It now installs that invalid hook explicitly at runtime instead of suppressing the type-aware promise rule. The exact rejection assertion, synchronous commit behavior, and every other case and assertion remain. Production grant types and validation are unchanged.

## Evidence

Both reported static failures reproduced on the base. After the fix:

- 63 focused tests pass across six single-file runs: incognito history (25), Talk store (9), Talk session (18), Talk recovery (3), query-index repair (5), and suppression inventory (3). Their wrapper wall times were 47.87s, 49.60s, 27.84s, 52.50s, 28.18s, and 10.69s respectively. No new test cases are scheduled; Linux CI seconds were not measured. The incognito history file is the shared helper's only importer across src, test, extensions, ui, and packages.
- An isolated temporary database probe captured the actual worker SQL. EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN uses idx_agent_voice_session_open_scope for legacy matching and idx_agent_voice_session_open_updated for stale lookups.
- Full architecture validation passes, including both cycle checks, four Kysely declaration tests, Kysely guardrails, and the legacy-store guard. Production types, all three affected test-type graphs, formatting, core lint, source/extension boundary checks, and the remaining changed-check guards pass.
- Direct-API Codex P2 review completed clean with no actionable findings. Reviewed source hashes match the candidate.

`check-changed` stops at inherited unused exports: one production export in `src/plugins/config-policy.ts` and seven full-tree constants in `src/media-understanding/defaults.ts`. The exact same findings reproduce with both changed files restored to the unmodified base; all remaining changed-check gates were run separately and passed. No scanner, baseline, or skip flag changed.

The Testbox lease stayed queued without a runner for more than 15 minutes and was stopped. No Linux command executed. This ready PR uses the coordinator-authorized capacity fallback; natural PR CI must provide remote proof, including the shared helper's sole importer and the owning configs. Local results above are not claimed as Linux results. The coordinator owns arming auto-merge.
